name: Thresher Eye
summary: Along Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle wants Thresher Eyes for his Buzzboxes. He uses them to repair Buzzbox 411 on the beach north of Auberdine.

sections.title: Ecological Samples for Gnomish Gadgets
sections.body: Darkshore Threshers hunt the surf and outer shallows off Darkshore. They threaten local fishermen and travelers, and their large eyes have caught the interest of Wizbang Cranktoggle. The gnome engineer is stationed nearby and fond of crawler wine. He needs the eyes to repair Buzzbox 411, a far-speaking communication machine on the beach north of Auberdine.

sections.title: The Purpose of the Eyes
sections.body: Wizbang does not explain how the slimy eyes repair delicate machinery. They might serve as crude lenses, chemical agents, or biological gears. Whatever the method, three eyes placed in Buzzbox 411's maintenance hatch restore its communication link, and Wizbang sends supplies through static-choked transmissions.

faq.q: Where do Thresher Eyes come from?
faq.answer: Thresher Eyes come from Darkshore Threshers and Elder Darkshore Threshers in the ocean off Darkshore, especially near Auberdine.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang Cranktoggle want Thresher Eyes?
faq.answer: Wizbang wants the eyes to repair Buzzbox 411, a gnomish machine on the shoreline north of Auberdine. Placing them in its hatch restores the machine's systems.

faq.q: How does an eye fix a machine?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle does not explain how an eye repairs a machine. The device accepts the eyes and powers back on, though whether he uses their retinas for focusing or builds with the organic parts remains unclear.

Buzzbox 411 is one of several communication and monitoring devices Wizbang Cranktoggle placed across Darkshore. When loaded with requested materials, it lets him communicate remotely and dispense supplies.

angles.text: Wizbang's use of animal parts to mend mechanical relays is an unusual example of gnomish engineering.
Wizbang Cranktoggle represents a wilder edge of gnomish ingenuity, tinkering with field machinery in Kalimdor's wilderness between cups of crawler wine.
